density_pruning.scope: Abstract hit-cube multiplication; geometric angular containment is an input.

collision_bins.scope: Atomic measures, including coincident atoms; constants chosen conservatively.

thermal_forms.scope: Finite spectral windows and periodic quadrature, not all coefficients or the Fourier-convergence procedure.

prescribed_marginal_variation.scope: Finite binary models; no verification of the source all-distribution moment hypothesis or later entropy compression.

likelihood_domination.scope: Finite likelihood truncations and entropy decomposition.

marginal_core.scope: Repeated observations with different comparison marginals are counted separately.

conformal_chart.scope: Exact rational chart identities away from D=0; no packet localization, band projection or transport estimate certified.

capacity_allocation.scope: Cell-capacity transfer conditional on the predecessor and overlap bounds.

limitations: Selected local and finite mechanisms only; no Falconer, L log L, Bochner-Riesz or local-smoothing theorem certified; no Lean build.
